keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «하나가 2100년으로 간다(사건)» 와 «미래 여행은 놀라운 일투성이다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the event (Hana goes to the year 2100) and the ending (her trip to the future is full of surprises). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Hana, Grandpa, and an old woman in a red hat
Hana pushes the red button and goes to the year 2100.
An old woman says she is Hana, and the trip is full of surprises.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: Grandpa builds a time machine in the garage.
a thing that does work for people
a small thing you push to make something work
machines that can move and do jobs
staying up in the air without falling
the time that comes after now

qs.q: Why is Hana suddenly in the year 2100?
opts: She pushes the button on the time machine.
She falls asleep in the park.
She reads a book about robots.
evs: Hana pushes the big red button.
Kids learn in a floating school.
Then Hana sees an old woman in a red hat.
why: 하나가 타임머신의 커다란 빨간 단추를 눌러요. 그러자 번쩍! 2100년으로 가요.
Hana pushes the big red button on the time machine. Then, flash, she is in 2100.

qs.q: The old woman says, "I am you!" What does she mean?
qs.qko: 할머니가 «내가 바로 너란다!» 라고 해요. 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: She is Hana, all grown old in the future.
evs: Robots walk dogs in the park.
Grandpa builds a time machine in the garage.
Hana pushes the big red button.
Flash! She is in the year 2100!
why: 하나는 2100년, 먼 미래에 와 있어요. 그래서 그 할머니는 나이 든 미래의 하나라는 뜻이에요.
Hana is in the year 2100, far in the future. So the old woman is Hana, all grown old.

qs.q: What surprises does Hana see in the future?
qs.qko: 하나는 미래에서 어떤 놀라운 것들을 보나요?
opts: flying cars and a floating school
a snowy mountain and a ski trip
evs: Grandpa builds a time machine in the garage.
Kids learn in a floating school.
Hana pushes the big red button.
why: 자동차가 하늘을 날고, 아이들은 떠다니는 학교에서 공부해요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Cars fly in the sky, and kids learn in a floating school. You need both sentences.

ends: Old Hana shows young Hana her future house.
할머니가 된 하나가 어린 하나에게 미래의 집을 보여 준다.
Hana pushes the button again and visits the dinosaurs.
하나가 단추를 다시 눌러 공룡 시대에 간다.

write.src: “I want to <u>visit the future</u> because <u>I want to see flying cars</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friends like it)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friends like it)

img.cover: Hana, a girl with two short black braids, a red hair clip, a yellow raincoat and blue boots, steps out of a round silver time machine with blinking lights into a bright future city, where cars fly between tall glass towers and a school floats in the sky above a green park.

scenes.1: In a green park of the future, Hana, a girl with two short black braids, a red hair clip, a yellow raincoat and blue boots, stares with her mouth open at shiny robots walking happy dogs on leashes, while kids wave from the windows of a school floating in the air and cars fly overhead.
scenes.2: On a sunny path in the future park, an old woman with silver hair in two short braids, a red hat and a yellow coat bends down, smiles and holds the hand of Hana, a girl with two short black braids, a red hair clip, a yellow raincoat and blue boots, who looks up at her with big surprised eyes.
